transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I'm just... really tired. It's not the kind of tired that a good night's sleep fixes. Just getting through a day at work, and then coming home to make dinner... it all just feels a lot heavier than it used to.
Have you been feeling sad or down most of the time lately?
Yeah, I guess so. Most days lately, I just... I wake up with this heavy, gray feeling. It's like I'm already disappointed in the day before it even really starts.
Do you find yourself enjoying things you used to like?

Not really, no. I mean... I usually like painting, or going to museum exhibits. But recently... I don't know. My supplies are just sitting there untouched. I just can't really make myself care enough to go out and do any of it.
Do you feel like you've lost interest in activities that normally bring you pleasure?
Um... yeah. Like I just mentioned with the painting and the exhibits... I just don't have any interest in them right now.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite lately?

Um... I guess maybe a little. I've just been... picking at my meals, mostly. Sometimes I forget to eat lunch at work. I did notice my skirts are a little looser lately, but... I haven't been trying to lose weight or anything.
Have you been having trouble sleeping lately?

Um... yeah, I suppose so. I'll go to bed at a reasonable hour, but... I just end up waking up around four or five in the morning. And then I just lie there thinking about work, or... my marriage, I guess. Once I'm awake like that, I'm just done sleeping. I can't really drift off again.
Do you feel like you're moving more slowly than usual or having trouble sitting still?

Um... I guess maybe slower. I don't know about moving, exactly, but... some of my staff mentioned something recently. They said I'm... a bit slower to answer questions in meetings lately. Like there's just a... a pause, I guess, before I can really get my thoughts and words moving. But... yeah.
Have you been feeling guilty about anything lately?

Um... I guess so. I just... I keep thinking about things. Like... missing family plans, or... just tense conversations with my husband. I don't know, I just... I feel like I'm not doing a good job. Like I'm letting everyone down... as a wife, and a mother. And at work, too, as a manager. It's just... a lot on my mind, I guess.
Have you been having any thoughts about hurting yourself?
No. No, I haven't.
How long have you been feeling this way?

Um... about a month, I guess. It's been a bit of a shift. I was actually... pretty energized before that. Really driven, getting a lot done. But... yeah, this low feeling has been going on for about four weeks now.
Have you been feeling restless or fidgety, like you can't sit still?
Um... no. Not really. I haven't noticed feeling like that.
Have you been experiencing significant distress or impairment in your social or occupational functioning due to these feelings?

I mean... I'm still showing up for work. Doing what I need to at home. It's not like I've stopped functioning. I guess I'm just... maybe a little slower making decisions at the office right now. And... I've been canceling on family a bit more. I haven't really been doing my art, either. But... I'm managing.
Would you say that these feelings of sadness and tiredness are interfering with your daily life a lot, or just somewhat?

Um... probably just somewhat. Like I was saying, I'm still showing up for work and taking care of my responsibilities at home. It's just... I'm slower with decisions right now. And... I guess I've been less reliable with family plans, and just kind of withdrawn from my art. But... no, not a lot. Just somewhat.
Would you describe your current feelings of sadness and tiredness as mild or moderate?
Um... mild, I suppose. It's really not that bad.
Would you say your feelings of sadness and tiredness are getting worse, staying the same, or getting better over the past month?
Um... I'm not really sure. I guess they're just... staying the same. I haven't really noticed much of a change.
Would you say your feelings of sadness and tiredness are significantly impacting your ability to function in daily life?

Um... no, not significantly. Like I mentioned a minute ago... I'm still going to work and taking care of things at home. I'm just... you know, taking a bit longer to make decisions at work... and skipping some family plans. And I just haven't been doing my art lately. But... no, I'm still functioning fine.
Have you been feeling hopeless about the future?

Um... hopeless is a strong word. I don't really know about the future. It's just... most days lately, I wake up with this... heavy, gray feeling. Just sort of... like I'm already disappointed in the day before it even starts. But I wouldn't necessarily say hopeless.
Would you say your feelings of sadness and tiredness are more like a gentle fog or a heavy burden that's really weighing you down?
Um... I'm not really sure. I don't really think about it like that. I guess... maybe just a fog? It's definitely not a heavy burden. It's just... kind of there. I don't know.
Would you say your feelings of sadness and tiredness are interfering with your daily life more than they were a couple of weeks ago?

Um... I don't think it's worse than a couple of weeks ago. Like I said... I'm still going to work. I'm still doing what I need to do at home. I mean... yeah, maybe I'm a little slower making decisions at the office, and I've backed out of a few family things... and I haven't picked up a paintbrush in a while. But... it's about the same as it has been. I'm still doing what I have to do.
Would you say your feelings of sadness and tiredness are more than a mild annoyance but not completely overwhelming?
I suppose... yeah, maybe. It's definitely not overwhelming. It's just... something I'm dealing with right now. I don't really know how else to describe it.
